# railway_environment (Resource)

An independently managed Railway environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "railway_environment" "staging" {
  project_id           = railway_project.example.id
  name                 = "staging"
  skip_initial_deploys = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `is_ephemeral` (Boolean)
- `skip_initial_deploys` (Boolean)
- `source_environment_id` (String)
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `config_etag` (String) Opaque optimistic-concurrency token used for environment changes.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
